name: Restricted Derivability Classification
purpose: Classify the formal derivability status of MT-001, MT-002, and MT-003 without escalation inflation.

classification_levels.definition: No formal local proof attempt has been made.
Proof construction is halted due to insufficient substrate or critical audit failure.
The proof is formally contested by one or more active counterexamples.
Some proof steps have been constructed but the chain to FSUB is incomplete.
The theorem is formally derivable within a restricted neighborhood IF all declared assumptions are granted.
The local proof attempt is complete and ready for external-style review under restricted assumptions.

forbidden_levels.rule: Promotion to global validity is blocked.
Mapping to physical reality is blocked.
Claims of ontological truth are blocked.

governance_rules.rule: Status must be local and conditional.
Promotion to READY_FOR_PEER_REVIEW_PREPARATION requires passing the minimality and persistence audits.

forbidden_claims: Partial status implies eventual global success.
